The City of Salisbury is the most progressive council in South Australia, driving growth, jobs, housing and opportunity in the north. With a workforce of over 400 people, we offer the chance to collaborate with teams across the organisation to deliver meaningful, community-focused projects.
The City Infrastructure Department delivers asset management, capital works, and maintenance programs, as well as oversees lease management for local community and sporting clubs, and security and civil compliance functions.
Join us and see the positive impact your work can make.
About the role
The City of Salisbury is seeking three experienced Asset Engineers to join the Engineering Assets & Systems team within City Infrastructure. Opportunities are available across Civil, Roads and Drainage asset portfolios.
Reporting to the Divisional Head, Engineering Assets & Systems (Asset Engineer - Civil and Asset Engineer - Roads) or the Senior Stormwater Engineer (Asset Engineer - Drainage), you will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving asset management plans, undertaking engineering investigations and modelling, and supporting long-term infrastructure planning and investment decisions.
You will play a key role in managing and improving some of the City's most important infrastructure assets, including roads, drainage networks, wetlands, bridges, boardwalks, coastal assets, carparks, signage and stormwater infrastructure, helping ensure they continue to meet the needs of our growing community.

- Provide specialist engineering and asset management advice across the organisation.

You are a qualified engineer with experience in infrastructure asset management and a passion for delivering practical, long-term outcomes for communities. You combine strong technical capability with excellent communication skills and can confidently engage with a wide range of stakeholders. You are able to translate complex engineering and asset management information into clear, practical advice that supports informed decision-making.
You will also have
- Degree qualifications in Civil Engineering, equivalent qualifications, or proven extensive experience in asset management relating to civil infrastructure and stormwater.

Role Overview
The Residue Storage and Industrial Earthworks Civil Engineering Draftsperson prepares detailed civil engineering drawings, plans, sections, technical schedules, and as-constructed documentation in support of engineers and senior design personnel. The position specialises in residue storage and associated industrial civil infrastructure, including containment embankments and wall lifts, retaining structures and buttresses, earthworks, underdrainage, decant pipework, and underground services. Using approved engineering design information, survey data, and site records, the role translates technical requirements into coordinated construction, tender, excavation-planning, and quality-assurance drawing packages.
Key Responsibilities
1. Planning, Engineering Interpretation, and Preparation
- Review engineering design drawings, specifications, site surveys, existing service records, and work instructions to establish drafting requirements and deliverables.
- Interpret topographic and as-constructed survey data, reduced levels, coordinates, chainages, contours, and existing site conditions for incorporation into civil engineering drawings.
- Establish drawing files, relevant references, layouts, legends, scales, and documentation standards in line with project and company requirements.
2. Specialised Civil Engineering Drafting and Documentation
- Prepare general arrangement plans, detailed layouts, profiles, cross-sections, and construction details for residue storage embankments, retaining-wall lifts, buttresses, ramps, berms, and related civil earthworks.
- Develop detailed underdrainage, drainage, and decant drawings, including HDPE pipe and draincoil alignments, diameters, connection and tie-in details, invert levels, grades, and minimum cover requirements based on approved designs.
- Prepare and revise earthworks drawings showing existing and proposed surfaces, contours, crest levels, batter slopes, grading, cut-and-fill extents, and associated quantity tables.
- Produce excavation and dig-permit services plans showing known underground and above-ground services, proposed work boundaries, service interfaces, and potential conflicts for engineering and site review.
- Prepare setting-out information and supporting schedules, including coordinates, reduced levels, pipe quantities, drawing notes, and section references for construction coordination.
3. Survey Integration, Quality Assurance, and As-Constructed Records
- Use survey and as-constructed information to prepare QA plots, long-sections, and comparative drawings for underdrainage, decant installations, retaining walls, and related civil works.
- Document design levels, surveyed as-constructed levels, grades, and variances in tabulations and drawings for engineer review; identify discrepancies without independently certifying design or construction compliance.
- Incorporate redlines, approved design updates, and review comments, and maintain drawing accuracy, traceability, and issue status.
4. Technical Coordination, Quality Control, and File Management
- Coordinate drawing interfaces among earthworks, liner boundaries, access roads, pipelines, civil services, and adjacent infrastructure; flag potential conflicts or missing information to the responsible engineer or senior drafter.
- Check drawing dimensions, coordinates, annotations, levels, scales, sheets, and cross-references against source information and applicable project specifications.
- Maintain version-controlled CAD files, revision registers, drawing issue records, and supporting technical documentation; liaise with engineers, surveyors, supervisors, and other project personnel.
Technical Systems and Capabilities
- AutoCAD: Detailed civil engineering drafting, layouts, profiles, sections, schedules, and revision management.
- Autodesk Civil 3D: Surface and contour information, grading and earthworks representations, profile/section inputs, and coordinated civil drawing preparation.
- Propeller: Review and interpretation of drone-survey surfaces, terrain information, and site data for drafting and QA support.
- Nearmap: Review of aerial imagery and site context to assist infrastructure identification and drawing coordination.
- Applied Civil Drafting Skills: Interpreting survey coordinates and reduced levels; preparing chainage, grade, invert-level, and as-constructed variance tabulations; identifying services interfaces.
Qualifications and Experience
- Relevant qualification in civil engineering, civil engineering drafting, or a closely related discipline.
- At least one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in civil engineering drafting consistent with the role and applicable occupational requirements.
- Practical civil engineering drafting experience using AutoCAD; capability with Civil 3D and interpretation of engineering and survey data.
- Demonstrated ability to prepare detailed civil plans and sections for earthworks, retaining structures, drainage, underground services, or comparable civil infrastructure.
- Understanding of drawing QA, document control, construction interfaces, and the need to work under appropriate engineering direction.
- Experience in residue storage, industrial infrastructure, tailings, or water-management earthworks is highly desirable for assigned projects.
Working Conditions
Predominantly office/CAD-based work, with site visits and coordination at operational industrial locations as required by project needs and applicable inductions.

Heathgate Resources is Australia's leader in responsible and innovative uranium mining. We conduct In-Situ Recovery mining, an advanced uranium extraction method that minimises surface and environmental disturbance. 
We seek a talented Design Draftsperson to join a new team who will deliver a diverse portfolio of capital projects to support our operational performance, sustainability and business growth objectives.
Based at our Adelaide CBD Corporate Office, with occasional travel to the Beverley mining operation, this role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse range of infrastructure projects, producing the engineering drawings and technical documentation that turn concepts into reality.
About the Role
You will work closely with project managers to develop and maintain engineering drawings and technical documentation throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and design through to construction, commissioning and handover. Key responsibilities:
- Prepare concept, detailed design, construction and as-built drawings.
- Develop and maintain engineering documentation and drawing registers.
- Coordinate design information across civil, structural, mechanical, piping and electrical disciplines.
- Support engineers and project teams with design development and technical documentation.
- Manage drawing revisions, document control and project handover documentation.
- Ensure designs comply with relevant Australian Standards and project requirements.
About You
You are a detail-oriented Draftsperson with experience supporting engineering, mining, industrial, construction or infrastructure projects. You enjoy collaborating with technical teams and take pride in producing accurate, high-quality design documentation. You will also bring:
- Qualification in Engineering Design, Engineering Drafting, Mechanical Design or a related discipline.
- Proficiency with AutoCAD and 3D modelling software.
- Experience preparing and maintaining engineering drawings and technical documentation.
- Knowledge of Australian Standards and drafting best practice.
- Strong organisational skills and ability to support multiple concurrent projects.
Why Join Heathgate?
You will have the opportunity to be a key part of a professional team delivering high-value capital projects that are critical to the future of energy and resource development in Australia.  
An established South Australian privately-owned and operated mining company, we offer:
- The opportunity to work with highly capable professionals in a technically challenging and unique operating environment.
- Competitive remuneration, incentives and benefits.
- Supportive team environment with real influence on project outcomes and business performance.
Applications will be handled in strict confidence.  
Apply now or email your resume with covering email to careers@heathgate.com.au
candidates.teaser: Shape the infrastructure that powers the future of mining. Join Heathgate Resources as a Design Draftsperson in a new Capital Projects team.

candidates.title: Civil Estimator
candidates.abstract: Join a well-established, family-owned civil contractor in the Murraylands. Prepare competitive tenders for diverse infrastructure projects.
candidates.location: Murray Bridge, Riverland & Murray Mallee SA
candidates.content_text:
Take on a key role as a Civil Construction Estimator, working closely with management to prepare competitive tenders and drive continuous growth. Capitalise on your expertise in earthworks and subdivisions to secure high-quality infrastructure projects within the beautiful Murraylands region.
About your new role 
Reporting to the General Manager, you will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates and tender submissions for a range of civil construction projects. As the Civil Construction Estimator, you will identify opportunities and manage the tender process from concept to handover.
- Prepare accurate tender submissions.
- Develop detailed pricing schedules.
- Assess project risks and opportunities.
- Evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotations.
- Assist with operations team handovers.
What you will need to exceed
- Previous civil construction estimating experience.
- Strong knowledge of earthworks projects.
- Ability to interpret engineering drawings.
- High level of computer literacy.
- Current Australian driver's licence.
Your new company 
You will be joining a proudly family-owned and operated South Australian business with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality infrastructure, subdivision, and road construction projects. Operating within the Murraylands region, this well-established civil construction company offers a collaborative environment where your estimating expertise will directly support the continued success of the organisation.
What you will get in return
- Join a growing, family-owned business.
- Work closely with the management team.
- Secure future infrastructure projects collaboratively.
- Enjoy stability in the Murraylands region.
Next steps
If you are ready to apply for this Civil Construction Estimator role, please apply online.
Have a question before applying? Please contact:
Anthony Walters, Specialist, Client & Talent Partnership, Engineering & Construction, Randstad Australia, +61 403 149 970, anthony.walters@randstad.com.au
At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.
